findings: The scanned albedo/roughness/normal maps introduce visible aged grain on the near rail, column, floor and overhead eaves.
Timber now has a deeper varied brown-vermilion surface in the actual golden-hour light.
Per-instance metric UVs use geometry extent attributes; existing geometry/material buckets remain instanced.
Existing finite-radiance capture shader is chained with the timber shader.
All four map/provenance dependencies are recorded in the actual source hash.
limits: Architecture, camera and motion are preserved. The scene remains a procedural draft.
Main roof planes remain too dark, and landscape, ornaments and proportions remain unlike the photograph.
The scan improves timber surface/color variation; it does not establish photographic acceptance.
